facts.fact: Mmegi reports in July 2026 that Botswana continues to implement the Data Protection Act No. 18 of 2024, under which the Commission monitors compliance and issues enforcement orders.

Mmegi reports that the Information and Data Protection Commission issued a determination and enforcement order finding the DPSM E-Payslip portal not fully compliant with the Data Protection Act No. 18 of 2024, and DPSM suspended the portal on 22 July 2026.
The Information and Data Protection Commission is acting: it reviewed the E-Payslip portal, issued a determination and enforcement order, and guided DPSM through compliance in July 2026.
